title: Sliding Mode Controller (Reaching Law)
text: Design sliding mode controller based on reaching law, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Control Gain (K)} sets Control gain; {Task Mode} sets the block operation mode, {Sliding Coefficient Matrix (C)} sets the sliding coefficient, {Use externally sourced derivative} sets the derivative of state reference externally, {Output Switching Function}, {Reaching Law} sets the reaching law Constant, {Reaching Rate (Eta)} sets the reaching rate, {Power Rate Exponent (Alpha)} sets the power rate exponent, {Select Boundary Layer} sets the boundary layer function, {Enable zero-crossing detection} and {Phi} sets the boundary layer thickness. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x.ref.dot
ports.summary: Derivative of state reference trajectories vector

params.name: Task Mode
params.values: Block operation mode Regulation Mode (default) | Tracking Mode

params.name: Sliding Coefficient Matrix (C)
params.values: Sliding coefficient matrix 1 (default) | scalar | column vector | matrix

params.name: Use externally sourced derivative
params.values: Specify derivative of state reference externally off (default) | on

params.name: Reaching Law
params.values: Reaching law Constant Rate (default) | Exponential | Power Rate

params.name: Reaching Rate (Eta)
params.values: Reaching rate 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector

params.name: Control Gain (K)
params.values: Control gain 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector

params.name: Power Rate Exponent (Alpha)
params.values: Power rate exponent 0.01 (default) | positive scalar between 0 and 1 | column vector of positive values between 0 and 1

params.name: Select Boundary Layer
params.values: Boundary layer function Sign (default) | Relay | Hyperbolic Tangent | Saturation

params.name: Phi
params.values: Boundary layer thickness 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector
